propositions: fsck.py is pinned at exactly 800 lines (the hard cap) and cannot accept any changes including bug fixes due to CI module-size enforcement
fsck.py fuses four distinct concerns (per-ticket store validation, tracker-level health checks, report formatting, CLI driver) that grow independently with each new check added

the refactoring splits fsck.py into three modules by concern seam: fsck_scan.py (enumeration and per-ticket validators), fsck_tracker_health.py (tracker-level health checks), and a reduced fsck.py (command driver and report shaping)
per-ticket validator functions in fsck_scan.py are further decomposed below the C901 complexity threshold to retire debt from the complexity baseline instead of relocating it
external callers of fsck module attributes are preserved via module-level re-exports without modification to their source files
